lhcottage_wife.text: Welcome, welcome. The lighthouse is just across the footbridge. The wind does for hairdos.
Strumble Head Lighthouse was first lit in 1908 and it has been automatic since 1980. It flashes four times every fifteen seconds. We count along when we are bored.
In 1797 French troops landed near Fishguard, the last invasion of Britain. Local women in red shawls and tall hats looked like soldiers from far away. The French gave up.

lhcottage_child.text: The Irish ferry goes by from Fishguard. I wave. Nobody waves back, but that is a ferry for you.
